text:
Sara: quick heads-up — found a pasted sealed-secrets manifest in a partner slack thread that contains a base64 payload referencing vault transit key id: transit-key-prod-04
Tom: wait, is the secret material itself included or just an encrypted blob?
Sara: just the ciphertext + annotation `vault-transit:key=transit-key-prod-04` and an old path `secret/data/staging/app`; looks like someone pasted kubernetes secret yaml
vault-bot: [ALERT] Sensitive artifact detected in public channel: file/sealedmanifest.yml — severity: medium — https://remediation.runbook/secret-leak
Ellie: thanks @Sara — can you paste the snippet (sanitized) and the commit history? we need to know exposure window
Sara: sanitized snippet:
```
apiVersion: bitnami.com/v1alpha1
kind: SealedSecret
metadata:
  name: app-creds
spec:
  encryptedData:
    password: AgC1...== # includes tag vault-transit:key=transit-key-prod-04
```
Sara: exposure window looks like ~2h before deletion; message was in partner thread with 3 external users
Tom: plan: rotate the transit key -> generate new key in KMS, rewrap any backed-up ciphertexts, and revoke old key's decrypt permission. Also rotate any Vault DB keys if they were decrypted using transit
Ellie: on it — I'll create new transit key `transit-key-prod-04-rot1` in Vault and update policies. tagging question: do we need to rotate wrapped backup blobs in GCS?
Sara: yes — assume any persistent backups containing that ciphertext need rewrap. I'll open a ticket to list affected objects: `gsutil ls gs://backups/*app* | xargs -n1 gsutil cp` (manual triage)
Tom: oncall will coordinate prod changes; schedule 5m outage for rewrap job? prefer 0-downtime using rewrap pipeline
Ellie: I'll push a rewrap job to infra CI: `vault rewrap -from transit-key-prod-04 -to transit-key-prod-04-rot1 --prefix app-creds` and test on staging
Sara: timeline: immediate create new key + policy, run rewrap on backups, then rotate app secrets (reseal manifests + redeploy). I'll notify partners and legal if external users had access
vault-bot: [ACTION] Created incident P0-1743332221: vault-transit-exposure — assign to sec-eng
Tom: assigning to @ellie and @sara; tagging @legal for partner disclosure
Ellie: copying remediation playbook https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/vault-transit-rotation
Sara: docs note: add lint rule to detect `vault-transit:key=` in sealed manifests and block in commit hook
Tom: adding CI lint rule: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` snippet
```
-   repo: local
    hooks:
    -   id: block-sealed-transit-tags
        entry: scripts/check_no_transit_tag.sh
```
Sara: PR incoming from infra with the script, will request review from security
Ellie: after rewrap + policy changes, we'll run an audit to list decrypt requests to transit-key-prod-04 in the window: `vault audit list` and export JSON
Tom: good — follow-up: rotate any service accounts that had access to that path
Sara: agreed. follow-up checklist will be in the ticket. :thumbsup:
